Now I understand the uSWID header format:
- magic: 16 bytes GUID = 0x53424F4DD6BA2EACA3E67A52AAEE3BAF
- hdrver: 1 byte
- hdrsz: 2 bytes little-endian
- payloadsz: 4 bytes little-endian
- flags: 1 byte
- compression: 1 byte

The struct is 16+1+2+4+1+1 = 25 bytes. Let me find the uswid fuzzer to understand how the input is processed.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul -name "*.c" -path "*fuzz*" | xargs grep -l "uswid" 2>/dev/null; find /workspace/repo-vul -name "*.c" | xargs grep -l "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput" 2>/dev/null | head</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
